info.summary: Reflexology maps the body onto the feet, hands and ears; acupuncture points lie along meridians. Pressing a point is traditionally said to act on a distant organ.
info.summaryZh: 反射疗法认为全身在足、手、耳上有对应区域；穴位分布于经络上。传统认为按压某点可作用于远处器官。
facts: 361 standard acupoints on 14 meridians (WHO 2008).
WHO 标准经穴 361 个，分布于 14 条经脉。
Ear points follow GB/T 13734-2008 — the ear as an upside-down fetus.
耳穴依据 GB/T 13734-2008——耳廓如倒置的胎儿。
Effects are traditional claims, not proven treatment.
所述功效为传统说法，并非经证实的疗法。

info.summary: The frame of the body: supports, protects organs, anchors muscles, stores calcium and makes blood cells in the marrow.
info.summaryZh: 人体的支架：支撑身体、保护器官、附着肌肉、储存钙，并在骨髓中造血。
facts: 206 bones in an adult; about 270 at birth (some fuse).
成人 206 块骨；新生儿约 270 块（部分融合）。
Spine: 7 cervical, 12 thoracic, 5 lumbar vertebrae + sacrum + coccyx.
脊柱：颈椎 7、胸椎 12、腰椎 5，加骶骨与尾骨。
12 pairs of ribs; the lowest two “float”.
肋骨 12 对，最下两对为浮肋。
The femur is the longest and strongest bone.
股骨是人体最长、最强壮的骨。

info.summary: Muscles move the body by shortening. Skeletal muscles work in pairs across joints — one bends, the other straightens.
info.summaryZh: 肌肉通过收缩产生运动。骨骼肌跨关节成对工作——一块屈，一块伸。
facts: Over 600 skeletal muscles, about 40% of body weight.
骨骼肌 600 多块，约占体重 40%。
Biceps bends the elbow; triceps straightens it.
肱二头肌屈肘，肱三头肌伸肘。
Tap a muscle, then use Try to move its joint.
点选肌肉，再用“Try”活动关节。

info.summary: The heart pumps blood through arteries to every cell and back through veins; the lungs reload it with oxygen.
info.summaryZh: 心脏将血液经动脉泵送至全身细胞，再经静脉回流；肺为血液重新充氧。
facts: About 5 litres of blood, pumped round in ~1 minute at rest.
全身血液约 5 升，静息时约 1 分钟循环一周。
Resting heart rate 60–100 bpm; normal blood pressure under 120/80.
静息心率 60–100 次/分；正常血压低于 120/80。
Red = oxygen-rich, blue = oxygen-poor (by convention).
惯例：红色为富氧血，蓝色为缺氧血。

info.summary: The brain and spinal cord process signals; nerves carry them to and from every part of the body.
info.summaryZh: 脑和脊髓处理信号；神经将信号在全身各处往返传递。
facts: About 86 billion neurons in the brain.
大脑约有 860 亿个神经元。
The sciatic nerve is the longest and thickest nerve.
坐骨神经是人体最长、最粗的神经。
A stroke kills ~1.9 million neurons a minute — call 120 fast.
中风时每分钟约 190 万个神经元死亡——尽快拨打 120。

info.summary: Organs in the chest and abdomen breathe, digest, filter blood and regulate the body.
info.summaryZh: 胸腹腔器官负责呼吸、消化、过滤血液和调节全身。
facts: The liver is the largest internal organ (~1.5 kg).
肝是最大的内脏器官（约 1.5 公斤）。
Kidneys filter ~180 litres of blood plasma a day.
肾脏每天过滤约 180 升血浆。
The lungs hold about 6 litres of air.
肺总容量约 6 升。

info.summary: Food travels mouth → oesophagus → stomach → small intestine (absorption) → large intestine (water) over 1–3 days.
info.summaryZh: 食物经口→食管→胃→小肠（吸收）→大肠（吸收水分），全程约 1–3 天。
facts: The small intestine is about 6 m long.
小肠长约 6 米。
Stomach acid has a pH of about 1.5–3.5.
The pancreas makes insulin and digestive enzymes.
胰腺分泌胰岛素和消化酶。
